summary: Write a bounded GR log patch into an explicitly selected OpendTect well and read it back; send a survey horizon to the project and get a version of it into a survey.

losses: missing endpoints absent in native log
gamma unit label canonicalized to API
Sent as one point per node of the horizon's grid (x, y, z, inline, crossline), Z in milliseconds of two-way time as OpendTect stores it (float32)
A node without a value is sent with an empty z
unsupported: a survey not in time, or one that states no coordinate system
a send by an assistant: a person sends with their own key

losses: Written as a new horizon beside yours on the survey's grid; your horizon is never overwritten
OpendTect keeps each inline's Z in steps of that inline's range: a value off those steps moves by up to half a step, and the get reports each moved value
unsupported: a horizon off the survey's grid, in another coordinate system or not in time

redistribution: Ophiolite adapter source; OpendTect Free is installed by the user.
